An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<div><span data-as="p">First</span><span data-as="p">Second</span></div>'
    options = ConversionOptions(data_as_elements=[])
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
